realm_description: Not a fixed place, but what Maruto becomes when civilization falls out of balance. Harai is temporary by nature — when balance returns, it transforms back into Maruto, a cycle called The Great Turning.

primary.label: Survivor
primary.description: Endures; resilience is the value they hold above all others.
primary.guiding_promise: I will rise from the ash, proving that our light cannot be crushed.
primary.shadow_description: Treats every calm moment as the quiet before the next disaster, and lets no one close enough to prove otherwise.

secondary.label: Navigator
secondary.description: Reads currents no one else notices; calculates the way through when the group panics.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will find the true course, even when the stars are hidden.
secondary.shadow_description: Trusts only their own reading of the current, and stops listening for anyone else's.

wheel.central_question: Should we understand first, or endure first?

growth.label: Navigator
growth.description: Reads currents no one else notices; calculates the way through when the group panics.
growth.guiding_promise: I will find the true course, even when the stars are hidden.
growth.shadow_description: Trusts only their own reading of the current, and stops listening for anyone else's.

other_ally.label: Storyteller
other_ally.description: Keeps identity, memory, and meaning alive across generations; around their fire, people remember who they are.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will keep telling the story, so no one forgets who we are.
trait_descriptions: Keep the soul alive in words.
other_ally.shadow_description: Polishes the story so bright that the truth underneath quietly disappears.

quarter.label: Visionary
quarter.description: Sees the shape of what doesn't exist yet; sketches futures vivid enough to pull the world forward.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will keep dreaming even when the world insists on staying as it is.
quarter.shadow_description: Gets so lost sketching tomorrow that today is left to fend for itself.

opposite.label: Philosopher
opposite.description: Chases understanding for its own sake, deeper than any single answer.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will not stop asking until the world reveals what it truly is.
opposite.shadow_description: Keeps asking the next question until the moment for an answer has already passed.

realmmate.label: Reformer
realmmate.description: Driven by justice, dreads stagnation more than backlash.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I will not accept a broken world when a better one is possible.
realmmate.shadow_description: Burns down what was merely imperfect, mistaking any resistance for the enemy.

wheel.compatible_text: Reformer · Warden — fellow travelers of The Broken Heart.
